thesis: AI 代理人正從聊天介面走向作業系統層：Anthropic 統一工作流、榮耀與 Doubao 手機把代理人嵌入硬體、飛書把代理人引入企業協作——AI 已從工具升格為基礎架構。
thesis_en: AI agents are moving from chatbot interfaces to operating system infrastructure: Anthropic unifies its workspace, Honor and Doubao embed agents into hardware, Feishu brings agents into team collaboration. AI has graduated from tool to infrastructure.
thesis_note: 今日跨越四個版塊的核心訊號：AI 代理人的整合層級持續下沉。年初代理人還是外掛工具，現在已進入手機作業系統（榮耀 MagicOS 11、Doubao 手機）、企業協作平台（飛書 8.0）、統一創作工作流（Anthropic Claude）。與此同時，Meta 的付費訂閱牆與廣告平台 AI 市佔加速，提示代理商：客戶接觸 AI 增強工具的管道，正愈來愈受平台所控。
thesis_note_en: The core signal across four sections today: AI agent integration is moving deeper into the stack. What was once a chatbot add-on is now embedded in phone operating systems (Honor MagicOS 11, Doubao Phone), enterprise collaboration platforms (Feishu 8.0), and unified creative workflows (Anthropic Claude). Meanwhile, Meta's subscription paywall and accelerating Big Tech AI ad dominance signal that access to AI-enhanced tools is increasingly platform-controlled — something agencies must factor into client planning.
sources_note: 本報內容由 Mia AI 整合自 TechCrunch、Digiday、The Drum、Marketing Interactive、Google DeepMind Blog、Meta Newsroom、量子位、36氪、TechNode 及各平台官方公告，每則均核實原文連結與發布日期。
sources_note_en: Content compiled by Mia AI from TechCrunch, Digiday, The Drum, Marketing Interactive, Google DeepMind Blog, Meta Newsroom, QbitAI, 36Kr, TechNode, and official platform announcements. Each item verified with original permalink and publish date.

廣告平台 & 行銷科技
行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Anthropic 將 Claude 聊天、協作與 Artifacts 整合為單一介面
items.title_en: Anthropic Unifies Claude Chat, Cowork, and Artifacts Into One Interface
items.summary: Anthropic 把 Claude 聊天、Cowork 協作空間、Artifacts 及 Claude Design 合併為統一視窗，AI 自動路由請求，另新增可匯出為 PDF 或 PowerPoint 的簡報製作功能，優先向 Pro 與 Max 訂閱者推出。
items.summary_en: Anthropic merged Claude chat, Cowork, Artifacts, and Design into a single interface with automatic request routing; new presentation creation (exportable to PDF/PowerPoint) and collaborative docs roll out first to Pro and Max subscribers.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 代理商用 Claude 製作提案或報告，現在一個視窗搞定，減少工具切換，加快交付速度。
items.why_en: Agency teams using Claude for proposals or reports can now work in a single environment — less tab switching, faster delivery.
highlights: Claude 聊天、Cowork、Artifacts 及 Design 四個功能合併為同一視窗，AI 自動判斷路由，無需手動切換分頁。
新增簡報製作功能，可直接匯出 PDF 或 PowerPoint，協作文件功能同步上線。
功能優先向 Pro 與 Max 付費訂閱者推出，Max 訂閱者另有獨立電話支援通道。
highlights_en: Claude chat, Cowork, Artifacts, and Design merge into one window with automatic AI routing — no manual tab switching required.
New presentation creation tools export directly to PDF or PowerPoint, with collaborative document editing also launching.
Features roll out first to Pro and Max subscribers; Max subscribers also receive a dedicated phone support channel.

items.title: Google 推出 Gemini 3.8 Live 系列：97 語言即時視覺語音對話
items.title_en: Google Launches Gemini 3.8 Live for Real-Time Multilingual Voice and Visual AI
items.summary: Google 發布 Gemini 3.8 Live（成本效益版）及 3.8 Live Extended Thinking（複雜推理版），兩者均支援即時視覺情境、跨 97 種語言對話及後台工具執行，可透過 Gemini API、Google Workspace 及 Gemini 應用取用。
items.summary_en: Google released Gemini 3.8 Live (cost-efficient scale) and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking (complex reasoning), both supporting real-time visual context, multilingual conversations across 97 languages, and background tool execution — available via Gemini API, Google Workspace, and the Gemini app.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 即時多語言語音加視覺情境，為品牌互動體驗、AI 客服及多語言活動提供新基礎建設。
items.why_en: Real-time multilingual voice AI with visual context opens new possibilities for brand interactive experiences, AI customer service, and multilingual campaign activations.
highlights: 支援 97 種語言即時語音對話，同步理解視覺情境，適合多語言品牌體驗及客服場景。
Extended Thinking 版本具備複雜推理能力，可在後台並行執行工具，處理多步驟任務。
已透過 Gemini API 及 Google Workspace 開放使用，並整合至消費者版 Gemini 應用。
highlights_en: Supports real-time voice conversations across 97 languages with simultaneous visual context understanding.
The Extended Thinking variant adds complex reasoning with background tool execution for multi-step tasks.
Available now via Gemini API, Google Workspace, and the consumer Gemini app.

items.title: OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google 據報探索成立聯合 AI 自律監管機構
items.title_en: OpenAI, Anthropic and Google Reportedly Explore Joint AI Self-Regulatory Body
items.summary: OpenAI、Anthropic 及 Google 三大 AI 公司據報正探索成立類似 FINRA 的行業自律機構，在模型公開發布前進行獨立評估，惟其他競爭者對主導者制定規則的安排提出警告。
items.summary_en: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google are reportedly exploring a FINRA-style self-regulatory AI standards body to independently evaluate powerful models before release, though competitors warn against dominant players controlling the rules.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 模型治理框架若落地，將影響代理商採購 AI 工具的合規標準與客戶要求。
items.why_en: A formal AI standards body would create compliance requirements around AI tool procurement, directly affecting agency tool selection and client-facing AI policies.
highlights: 三大 AI 公司探索成立 FINRA 式自律機構，在模型公開發布前進行獨立安全評估。
方案由 Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis 率先提出，旨在回應 AI 能力超前對齊研究的業界壓力。
Cohere 等競爭者警告，由主導企業制定規則存在利益衝突，方案最終形態仍待確認。
highlights_en: The three major AI labs are exploring a FINRA-style self-regulatory body to independently evaluate models before public release.
The proposal was first raised by Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis in response to AI capabilities outpacing alignment research.
Competitors like Cohere have raised conflict-of-interest concerns about dominant players controlling the standards process.

items.title: 字節跳動上半年收入 1,200 億美元，利潤下滑換取 AI 基礎設施主導權
items.title_en: ByteDance H1 2026: $120B Revenue, Profit Falls as AI Capex Accelerates
items.summary: 字節跳動 2026 年上半年收入達 1,200 億美元（按年增約 30%），淨利潤降至約 200 億美元，原因是大幅增加 AI 雲端基礎設施及自研推理晶片投資。TikTok 國際廣告及電商、旗下 Seedance 影片 AI 模型被點名為主要增長驅動力。
items.summary_en: ByteDance reported H1 2026 revenue of $120B (up ~30% YoY) but net profit fell to ~$20B as the company accelerated investment in AI cloud infrastructure and proprietary inference chips. TikTok international advertising and e-commerce, plus Seedance video AI models, were highlighted as key growth pillars.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 字節跳動以短期利潤換取 AI 能力優勢，直接加速 TikTok 廣告工具及 Seedance 創意 AI 的演進速度。
items.why_en: ByteDance is trading near-term profit for AI capability leadership, directly accelerating TikTok ad AI tools and Seedance video generation that agencies rely on for performance campaigns.
highlights: H1 2026 收入達 1,200 億美元，按年增 30%，來自 TikTok 國際廣告、電商及抖音廣告的增長強勁。
淨利潤降至約 200 億美元，原因是大規模增加 AI 雲端基礎設施及自研推理晶片投資。
Seedance 影片 AI 模型被列為核心增長支柱，顯示字節跳動正全力押注 AI 創意生產工具。
highlights_en: H1 2026 revenue reached $120B, up ~30% YoY, driven by strong growth in TikTok international advertising, e-commerce, and Douyin ads.
Net profit fell to ~$20B as ByteDance significantly increased investment in AI cloud infrastructure and proprietary inference chips.
Seedance video AI models were named as a core growth pillar, signaling full commitment to AI creative production tools.

items.title: 豆包手機發布螢幕自動化宣告協議，AI 代理人可跨 App 執行多步任務
items.title_en: Doubao Phone Launches Screen Automation Declaration Protocol for Cross-App AI Agent Tasks
items.summary: 字節跳動豆包手機助手在努比亞 NaviX Ultra 上發布「螢幕自動化宣告協議」（SAEP），允許 AI 代理人透過單一語音指令執行跨 App 多步工作流；第三方 App 可在 30 天公眾意見期內選擇退出 GUI 代理人控制。
items.summary_en: ByteDance's Doubao phone assistant launched on the Nubia NaviX Ultra with a Screen Automation Declaration Protocol (SAEP), allowing the AI agent to execute multi-app workflows from a single voice command; third-party apps can opt out during a 30-day public comment period.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 若 SAEP 成為 Android 中國生態標準，將改變用戶探索與使用 App 的方式，影響代理商的 App 推廣策略。
items.why_en: If SAEP becomes an Android China platform standard, it will reshape how users discover and interact with apps, affecting agency App marketing strategies and user journey design for clients.
highlights: Doubao 手機在 NaviX Ultra 首發 SAEP 協議，AI 代理人可由單一語音指令跨 App 執行完整工作流。
協議設有 30 天公眾意見期，第三方 App 可選擇退出 GUI 代理人控制，引發對 App 生態控制權的廣泛討論。
若標準化落地，代理商為客戶設計的 App 行銷策略及用戶旅程將需要考慮代理人操控介面的使用情境。
highlights_en: Doubao Phone debuted SAEP on the Nubia NaviX Ultra, enabling AI agents to execute complete cross-app workflows from a single voice command.
The protocol includes a 30-day public comment period during which third-party apps can opt out of GUI agent control, sparking debate over ecosystem control.
If standardized, agency App marketing strategies and user journey designs will need to account for agent-mediated interfaces as a new user behavior mode.

items.title: 榮耀發布 MagicOS 11：行業首個系統級代理人 Harness 架構，月活達 1.6 億
items.title_en: Honor Launches MagicOS 11 With Industry-First System-Level Agent Harness OS Architecture
items.summary: 榮耀發布 MagicOS 11，搭載 YOYO Harness——行業首個系統級代理人 Harness 作業系統架構，可由單一指令執行 100 多個連續步驟，覆蓋 40 個觸發條件與 130 多個動作。月活躍用戶已達 1.6 億。
items.summary_en: Honor launched MagicOS 11 featuring YOYO Harness — the industry's first system-level Agent Harness OS architecture — capable of executing 100+ sequential steps from a single command across 40 trigger conditions and 130+ actions. Monthly active users reached 160 million.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 中國頂級手機廠商競相推出代理人原生作業系統，將從根本改變廣告及品牌 App 觸達用戶的方式。
items.why_en: China's top smartphone OEMs are racing to ship production-ready agentic OS layers, which will fundamentally change how ads and branded apps surface to users.
highlights: MagicOS 11 的 YOYO Harness 可由單一指令執行 100 多個連續步驟，覆蓋 40 個觸發條件與 130 多個動作。
榮耀月活躍用戶達 1.6 億，代理人原生 OS 的規模影響不可低估。
中國 Android 手機 OEM 競相建立代理人原生架構，可能重塑 App 內廣告及品牌觸點的長期形態。
highlights_en: MagicOS 11's YOYO Harness executes 100+ sequential steps from a single command across 40 trigger conditions and 130+ actions.
With 160 million monthly active users, the scale impact of an agent-native OS is significant.
China's Android OEMs are racing to build agent-native OS layers, potentially reshaping how in-app advertising and brand touchpoints work long-term.

items.title: Google 推出 Google Home MCP 伺服器，AI 代理人可控制智能家居裝置
items.title_en: Google Launches Google Home MCP Server, Letting AI Agents Control Smart Home Devices
items.summary: Google 開放 Google Home MCP 伺服器早期使用，允許 Claude 及 ChatGPT 等 AI 代理人透過自然語言控制 Nest 及 Matter 相容智能家居裝置。目前僅限美國 Google Home Premium Advanced 訂閱者（每月 20 美元）使用。
items.summary_en: Google launched early access to a Google Home MCP server, letting AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT control Nest and Matter-compatible smart home devices via natural language. Currently limited to U.S. Google Home Premium Advanced subscribers at $20/month.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 代理人延伸至實體環境，為零售體驗及品牌活動的智能化佈局指出近期方向。
items.why_en: AI agents extending into physical environments point to near-term possibilities for smart retail experiences and brand activations — worth tracking even though the feature is US-only for now.
highlights: Google Home MCP 伺服器允許 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 代理人透過自然語言指令控制 Nest 及 Matter 智能家居裝置。
目前以早期使用形式推出，僅限美國每月 20 美元 Premium Advanced 訂閱者，短期內尚未擴展至亞洲。
此舉標誌 AI 代理人從數位介面延伸至實體空間，為未來智能零售及品牌沉浸式體驗開拓基礎建設。
highlights_en: Google Home MCP server enables Claude and ChatGPT to control Nest and Matter-compatible devices via natural language commands.
Currently in early access for US Google Home Premium Advanced subscribers at $20/month; Asia rollout is not yet on the roadmap.
This marks AI agents extending from digital interfaces into physical spaces, laying groundwork for future smart retail and immersive brand experiences.

items.title: Meta 推出付費訂閱 Meta One，進階 AI 工具與創作功能進入收費牆
items.title_en: Meta Launches Meta One Paid Subscriptions, Gating Advanced AI Tools Behind Paywalls
items.summary: Meta 推出跨 Instagram、Facebook、WhatsApp 及 Meta AI 的分級付費訂閱服務 Meta One，個人版起步價 2.99 美元／月，企業版最高 499 美元／月，提供擴展 AI 功能、創作者工具及 Meta Business Agent 自動客戶互動服務，核心應用功能維持免費。
items.summary_en: Meta launched Meta One, a tiered subscription service across Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, and Meta AI, offering enhanced AI usage, creator tools, and a Business Agent for 24/7 automated customer responses. Plans start at $2.99/month; core app features remain free.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 代理商客戶若要取用 Meta 平台進階 AI 廣告與創作工具，需納入訂閱成本，客戶預算規劃因此改變。
items.why_en: Agency clients who want access to Meta's advanced AI marketing and creative tools now face a new subscription cost layer — agencies must factor Meta One into media and tool budgets.
highlights: Meta One 分級訂閱橫跨 IG、FB、WhatsApp 及 Meta AI，個人版起步 2.99 美元／月，企業版最高 499 美元／月。
企業方案解鎖 Meta Business Agent（24/7 自動回應）、限時動態提前排程（最長 30 天）及有機貼文加入連結等功能。
Meta 報告已有 1,500 萬個訂閱與試用帳戶，核心應用功能目前仍維持免費。
highlights_en: Meta One tiers span IG, FB, WhatsApp, and Meta AI — personal plans start at $2.99/month, business plans up to $499/month.
Business plans unlock Meta Business Agent (24/7 automated responses), Stories scheduling up to 30 days ahead, and links in organic posts.
Meta reports 15 million subscriptions and trials; core app features remain free.
items.pattern: 代理商可立即評估企業版 Meta One 的 Meta Business Agent（自動回應客戶諮詢）及貼文排程功能，判斷是否值得為客戶訂閱升級，並將訂閱成本納入下季社群管理報價。
items.pattern_en: Agencies should evaluate whether Meta One's Business Agent and scheduling features justify the subscription cost per client, and incorporate it into next-quarter social management pricing proposals.

items.title: Digiday：AI 自動化工具強化三大科技公司廣告壟斷，佔美國廣告收入 56%
items.title_en: Digiday: AI Ad Tools Reinforce Big Tech's Grip, Now 56% of US Ad Revenue
items.summary: Google、Meta 及 Amazon 合計佔美國廣告收入 56%（前一年 53%），Performance Max 與 Advantage+ 等 AI 自動化工具現處理約 12% 美國廣告支出（2023 年僅 2%），預計至 2030 年升至 27%，形成幾乎不可逆的自我強化迴圈。
items.summary_en: Google, Meta, and Amazon now control 56% of U.S. ad revenue (up from 53%), driven by AI-automated tools like Performance Max and Advantage+ now handling ~12% of US ad spend (vs. 2% in 2023), projected to reach 27% by 2030.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: AI 自動化工具正壓縮人工媒體策劃的價值，代理商需要重新定位在量度與策略上的核心優勢。
items.why_en: AI automation on Big Tech platforms compresses the value of human media planning, requiring agencies to reposition their expertise around measurement and strategy rather than execution.
highlights: Google、Meta、Amazon 三強合計佔美國廣告收入 56%，AI 自動化工具是增長主因，市佔持續擴大。
Performance Max 與 Advantage+ 所佔廣告支出由 2023 年 2% 急升至目前 12%，預計 2030 年達 27%。
平台算法以消費廣告預算強化自身精準度的正向迴圈，使市場集中度難以逆轉，代理商須調整服務定位。
highlights_en: Google, Meta, and Amazon control 56% of US ad revenue, up from 53%, with AI-automated tools as the primary growth driver.
Performance Max and Advantage+ now handle ~12% of US ad spend (up from 2% in 2023), projected to reach 27% by 2030.
The self-reinforcing algorithm loop — more spend leads to better optimization, which attracts more spend — makes concentration nearly irreversible.

items.title: Kroger 零售媒體 Q2 獲利創五年新高，AI 購物助手整合廣告推動業績
items.title_en: Kroger Retail Media Posts Strongest Profit Growth Since 2021, Fueled by AI Shopping Integration
items.summary: Kroger Precision Marketing 於 2026 年 Q2 錄得 24% 利潤增長，為近五年最佳零售媒體表現，主要受 Google 及 TikTok 合作擴展、門店數位螢幕及 AI 購物助手廣告整合帶動。
items.summary_en: Kroger Precision Marketing posted 24% profit growth in Q2 2026 — its strongest retail media performance in five years — driven by expanded Google and TikTok partnerships, in-store digital screens, and ads integrated into its AI-powered shopping assistant.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 美國零售媒體高速增長是亞洲市場的先行指標，代理商應提前布局零售媒體服務能力。
items.why_en: Retail media's explosive US growth is a leading indicator for Asia: agencies should build retail media planning capabilities ahead of client demand in regional e-commerce.
highlights: Kroger Precision Marketing Q2 利潤增長 24%，受 Google 與 TikTok 合作擴展及 AI 購物助手廣告整合帶動。
AI 購物助手直接內嵌廣告單元，標誌零售媒體進入「對話式廣告」新階段。
美國零售媒體快速成熟，亞洲電商平台料將加快跟進，代理商宜預先建立相關服務能力。
highlights_en: Kroger Precision Marketing posted 24% Q2 profit growth driven by Google and TikTok partnerships and AI shopping assistant ad integration.
Ads embedded directly in AI shopping assistants mark retail media's entry into the 'conversational advertising' phase.
As US retail media matures, Asian platforms are expected to accelerate similar models, making early capability-building essential for agencies.

items.title: 可靈 AI VIDEO 3.0 官方教學：保持角色一致性、自然動作與 4K 慢動作製作
items.title_en: Kling AI VIDEO 3.0 Official Tutorial: Identity Consistency, Natural Motion, and 4K Slow Motion
items.summary: 可靈 AI 官方發布 VIDEO 3.0 Omni 的逐步教學，介紹如何在影片各幀間保持角色外觀一致性、以結構化提示詞達到自然動作與鏡頭表現，以及製作最長 15 秒 4K 解析度影片。
items.summary_en: Kling AI published an official step-by-step tutorial for VIDEO 3.0 Omni, covering identity consistency across frames, structured prompts for natural motion and camera behavior, and producing up to 15-second 4K outputs.
items.why: 官方教學提供結構化提示框架，大幅縮短製作品牌產品短片的試錯時間。
items.why_en: The official tutorial provides a structured prompt framework that significantly cuts trial-and-error time for producing brand product videos.
highlights: 官方教學涵蓋保持人物或產品視覺一致性的四步流程：定義需保持一致的元素、建立參考輸入、結構化提示詞與逐幀審查。
建議提示詞格式：「主體＋動作＋表情＋鏡頭＋環境＋燈光＋聲音」，能有效提升動作流暢度。
同日配套發布慢動作教學，示範如何由圖片提示產生 4K 慢動作電影感效果，最長可達 15 秒。
highlights_en: The tutorial covers a four-step process for maintaining visual identity consistency: define what to keep consistent, build reference inputs, structure the prompt, and review the full sequence.
Recommended prompt format: 'subject + action + expression + camera + environment + lighting + audio' — consistently improves motion quality.
A companion slow-motion tutorial published the same day covers producing cinematic 4K slow-motion effects from image prompts.

items.title: 飛書 8.0 發布「豆包工作夥伴」：AI 代理人全天候加入群聊與會議
items.title_en: Feishu 8.0 Launches Doubao Work Partner — an AI Agent That Joins Group Chats and Attends Meetings 24/7
items.summary: ByteDance 在 2026 飛書未來無限大會上發布飛書 8.0 及「豆包工作夥伴」，這是中國首個讓 AI 代理人全天候加入群聊、出席會議並自主推進工作任務的團隊智能產品，飛書平台亦同步重新設計為代理人原生架構。
items.summary_en: ByteDance unveiled Feishu 8.0 and Doubao Work Partner at the 2026 Feishu Future Unlimited Conference — China's first team intelligence product where an AI agent joins group chats, attends meetings, and autonomously advances tasks 24/7, with the entire platform redesigned for agent-native operation.
items.why: 使用 Lark／飛書的代理商可評估豆包工作夥伴能否自動化活動報告、Brief 工作流及跨組協調。
items.why_en: Agencies using Lark/Feishu should evaluate whether Doubao Work Partner can automate campaign reporting, briefing workflows, and cross-team coordination.
highlights: 飛書 8.0 引入「豆包工作夥伴」，AI 代理人可全天候加入群聊、出席會議並自主推進工作任務，為中國企業軟體首例。
飛書整個平台介面重新設計為代理人原生架構，AI 代理人能以與人類相同的操作方式使用辦公工具。
對以飛書作為核心協作平台的代理商而言，豆包工作夥伴可能顯著改變項目管理及客戶溝通的工作方式。
highlights_en: Feishu 8.0 introduces Doubao Work Partner — an AI agent that joins group chats, attends meetings, and autonomously advances tasks 24/7, a first in China's enterprise software.
The entire Feishu platform was redesigned to be agent-native, allowing AI agents to operate workplace tools the same way humans do.
For agencies using Feishu as their core collaboration platform, Doubao Work Partner may significantly change project management and client communication workflows.

items.title: Bilibili 推出 AI 無限競技場，百大模型角逐，三款中國模型進入前五
items.title_en: Bilibili Launches AI Infinite Arena: 100+ Models Ranked, Three Chinese Models in Top Five
items.summary: Bilibili 於 9 月 16 日推出 AI 無限競技場，透過 UP 主創作者貢獻的真實使用評估，對數百個 AI 模型進行公開排名。初始榜首為 GPT-6 Astra，前五名中有三款中國本土模型上榜。
items.summary_en: Bilibili launched its AI Infinite Arena on September 16, aggregating real-world AI model evaluations contributed by UP creators across hundreds of models. GPT-6 Astra topped the initial leaderboard with three domestic Chinese models placing in the top five.
items.why: 三款國產模型進入前五，顯示中國 AI 在創意生成質量上已接近全球頂尖水準，代理商可參考排名選取工作流工具。
items.why_en: Three Chinese models in the top five signals convergence with global AI leaders in creative generation quality — agencies can use the leaderboard to benchmark tools for creative workflows.
highlights: Bilibili 利用 UP 主社群的真實創作評估建立公開 AI 排名榜，覆蓋數百個模型，開放社群貢獻。
初始榜首為 GPT-6 Astra，前五名中有三款中國本土模型，反映國產 AI 創意能力的快速進步。
此以真實使用場景為基礎的排名，為代理商提供比廠商自測基準測試更具參考價值的中立評估。
highlights_en: Bilibili built a public AI ranking using real-world creative evaluations from its UP creator community, covering hundreds of models.
GPT-6 Astra topped the initial leaderboard, with three domestic Chinese models in the top five, reflecting rapid advances in domestic AI creative quality.
This creator-sourced ranking offers agencies a neutral, real-world benchmark more practical than vendor-run tests.

items.title: Grab 以 14.9 億美元收購 Atome Financial 六成股份，構建東南亞最大消費數據生態
items.title_en: Grab Acquires 60% of Atome Financial for $1.49B, Building Southeast Asia's Largest Consumer Data Ecosystem
items.summary: Grab 宣布以 14.9 億美元收購 Atome Financial（先進智能集團旗下數位貸款業務）60% 股份，將 Atome 擁有 2,500 萬用戶及 3 萬個品牌合作夥伴的 AI 驅動先買後付及貸款基礎設施，與 Grab 5,400 萬月活躍交易用戶整合。
items.summary_en: Grab announced a $1.49B acquisition of 60% of Atome Financial, merging Atome's AI-powered BNPL and lending infrastructure (25M users, 30,000+ brand partners) with Grab's 54 million monthly transacting users across five Southeast Asian markets.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 超級應用交易數據與 AI 貸款平台的整合，將形成東南亞最強消費者受眾定向能力，為區域廣告客戶開拓新觸點。
items.why_en: Merging a super-app's transaction data with an AI lending platform creates one of Southeast Asia's most powerful consumer targeting ecosystems, opening new audience and commerce touchpoints for regional brand campaigns.
highlights: Grab 以 14.9 億美元收購 Atome Financial 六成股份，整合雙方消費數據與金融基礎設施，覆蓋東南亞五個市場。
Atome Financial 擁有 2,500 萬用戶及 3 萬個品牌合作夥伴，其 AI 驅動先買後付與貸款能力將直接融入 Grab 生態。
合並後形成的龐大消費者數據池，將大幅提升品牌廣告在東南亞的精準定向能力。
highlights_en: Grab is acquiring 60% of Atome Financial for $1.49B, integrating consumer data and financial infrastructure across five Southeast Asian markets.
Atome Financial has 25M users and 30,000+ brand partners; its AI-powered BNPL and lending capabilities integrate directly into the Grab ecosystem.
The combined entity creates one of Southeast Asia's most powerful consumer data pools for brand targeting.

items.title: The Drum 紀錄片：AI 正在重塑 CMO 角色，代理商按時計費模式亦面臨終結
items.title_en: The Drum Documentary: AI Is Reshaping the CMO Role, and Agency Hourly Billing Faces Disruption
items.summary: The Drum 推出三集紀錄片系列，探討 AI、消費者行為轉變與商業問責如何迫使 CMO 重構策略與運營模式，品牌方強調須證明銷售增量，代理商主管則呼籲終結按小時計費，改以固定費用專案制取代。
items.summary_en: The Drum's new three-part documentary series examines how AI, shifting consumer behavior, and commercial accountability are forcing CMOs to reinvent strategy and operating models, with agency heads calling for an end to hourly billing in favor of fixed-fee project work.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 計費模式轉向成效導向固定費用是亞太市場的趨勢信號，提前調整定價策略的代理商將佔競爭優勢。
items.why_en: The shift to fixed-fee, outcome-based pricing is a global trend signal — agencies that adapt early will gain competitive advantage in the Asia-Pacific market.
highlights: 多位代理商主管公開呼籲終結按小時計費模式，主張轉向固定費用專案制，凸顯 AI 工具削減人工時數後的定價矛盾。
品牌方日益要求代理商以可量化的銷售增量論功行賞，推動代理商關是從服務提供轉向業績合作。
三集系列訪問 Samsung 歐洲等品牌主管及頂尖代理商領袖，呈現 CMO 角色重構的全貌。
highlights_en: Multiple agency leaders called for ending hourly billing, advocating fixed-fee project models as AI tools reduce billable hours.
Brand marketers increasingly demand measurable sales lift, shifting the client relationship from service delivery to performance partnership.
The three-part documentary features Samsung Europe and other major brand and agency leaders on the full scope of CMO role reinvention.

items.title: Mastercard 解除與 Ketchum 14 年合作，委任 We Communications 主打 AI 及代理商業務敘事
items.title_en: Mastercard Ends 14-Year Ketchum Relationship, Appoints We Communications for AI and Agentic Commerce PR
items.summary: Mastercard 在六個月競爭提案後選擇 We Communications 取代 Ketchum，成為全球公關代理機構，職責明確涵蓋 AI、代理商業務及網路安全敘事，工作已在進行中。
items.summary_en: Mastercard replaced Ketchum with We Communications as its global PR agency after a six-month review, with the remit explicitly covering AI, agentic commerce, and cybersecurity narratives alongside the iconic 'Priceless' platform.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 主要全球品牌更換代理機構的標準已明確包含 AI 故事建構能力，欠缺此能力的代理商在競爭提案中將日益弱勢。
items.why_en: A major global brand's agency selection criteria now explicitly includes AI storytelling capability — agencies lacking this face growing vulnerability in competitive pitches.
highlights: Mastercard 終止與 Ketchum 長達 14 年的合作，經六個月競爭提案後委任 We Communications。
新職責明確涵蓋 AI、代理商業務及網路安全的傳播敘事，而非只是沿用「無價」品牌平台的傳統公關工作。
此次更換代理的決策，清楚釋出信號：AI 故事建構能力已成為全球品牌選擇代理機構的新基本門檻。
highlights_en: Mastercard ended its 14-year relationship with Ketchum, selecting We Communications after a six-month competitive review.
The new remit explicitly covers AI, agentic commerce, and cybersecurity narratives — beyond traditional PR around the 'Priceless' platform.
The agency switch signals clearly that AI storytelling capability is now a baseline expectation for major global brand agency selection.

items.title: Google Shopping 推出 AI 成效洞察、YouTube 商業代理人及對話式商品屬性
items.title_en: Google Shopping Launches AI Performance Insights, YouTube Business Agent, and Conversational Product Attributes
items.summary: Google Shopping 推出多項 AI 更新：AI 成效洞察（在 AI 模式中顯示市佔聲音，已在澳洲、加拿大等市場全面上線）、YouTube 廣告內商業代理人 Beta（讓購物者在觀看影片時直接詢問產品問題）、以及商品目錄對話式屬性（提升 AI 推薦曝光率）。
items.summary_en: Google Shopping rolled out AI Performance Insights (now GA in AU, CA, IN, NZ, US) showing share of voice in AI Mode; a YouTube Business Agent beta lets shoppers ask product questions within video ads; and Conversational Attributes in product feeds boost visibility in AI-driven recommendations.
items.why: 即可審計商品目錄並填入對話式屬性——lululemon 測試顯示能令商品在 AI 推薦中出現率提升 50%。
items.why_en: Audit Merchant Center feeds and submit Conversational Attributes now — lululemon tests showed product attributes appeared in 50% of relevant AI Mode recommendations.
highlights: AI 成效洞察已在澳洲、加拿大、印度、紐西蘭及美國全面上線，可追蹤品牌在 Google AI 模式中的市佔聲音表現。
YouTube 商業代理人 Beta 讓消費者在廣告影片中即時詢問產品問題，廣告正式從展示走向互動對話。
Lululemon 測試顯示，填入對話式商品屬性後，商品在 AI 模式推薦中的出現率提升 50%，立即可行動。
highlights_en: AI Performance Insights is now GA in AU, CA, IN, NZ, and US — brands can track share of voice in Google AI Mode results.
YouTube Business Agent beta enables shoppers to ask product questions in real time within video ads, shifting ads from display to interactive dialogue.
Lululemon tests showed adding Conversational Attributes boosted product appearances in AI Mode recommendations by 50% — actionable immediately.

items.title: Threads 推出播客工具包：節目卡、Insights 數據面板及自動提醒一站式上線
items.title_en: Threads Launches Podcast Toolkit: Episode Cards, Insights Dashboard, and Auto-Reminders
items.summary: Meta 推出 Threads 播客工具包，包含個人資料橫幅、可點擊節目集數連結卡、嘉賓及文字稿卡、聽眾儲存功能、新集數自動提醒選項，以及追蹤觸及率、點擊數與儲存次數的 Podcast Insights 數據面板。
items.summary_en: Threads introduced a dedicated podcast toolkit featuring profile and post banners, tappable episode link cards, guest/transcript cards, episode saving, opt-in auto-reminders for new episode posts, and a Podcast Insights dashboard tracking reach, clicks, and saves.
items.why: 代理商現在可在 Threads 以原生集數卡推廣客戶播客，並用 Insights 面板追蹤成效，毋需依賴第三方工具。
items.why_en: Agencies managing branded podcasts can now promote episodes on Threads natively with rich episode cards and track performance via the Insights dashboard, without third-party link tools.
highlights: Threads 播客工具包包含個人資料橫幅、可點擊節目集數連結卡及 Podcast Insights 數據面板，全部免費開放。
嘉賓卡及文字稿卡功能有助帶動討論，新集數自動提醒讓已追蹤帳號的聽眾不會錯過更新。
即時可行動：在客戶 Threads 個人資料加入播客橫幅，下一集改用集數卡形式發布，再接入 Insights 追蹤成效。
highlights_en: The Threads podcast toolkit includes profile banners, tappable episode cards, and a Podcast Insights dashboard — all free.
Guest cards and transcript cards drive discussion; opt-in auto-reminders ensure followers do not miss new episode drops.
Immediate action: add a podcast banner to the client's Threads profile, post the next episode as a card, and connect the Insights dashboard to track performance.
